description: This file defines serialization and copying logic for HashSet<T> in Orleans, including a serializer class HashSetCodec<T> and a copier class HashSetCopier<T>, providing methods for writing, reading, and deep copying HashSet instances.

classes.name: HashSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for HashSet<T>, implementing methods for serialization and deserialization of HashSet instances.

classes.name: HashSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Copier for HashSet<T>, providing deep copy capabilities.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.WriteField
methods.description: Writes a HashSet<T> to the buffer, including optional comparer and elements.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a HashSet<T> from the buffer, reconstructing it with proper comparer and elements.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the HashSet<T> content to the buffer.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes and populates a HashSet<T> from the buffer.

methods.name: HashSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a HashSet<T>.

methods.name: HashSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Copies elements from an input HashSet<T> to an output HashSet<T>.
